messages:
Mina: Quick sync after the PM: we need concrete follow-ups to stop repeat KV-eviction incidents. Small list below with owners/timelines.
Carlos: Please prioritise anything that removes outage risk or speeds recovery.
Mina: Agreed. Proposed items: (A) curated prompt/regression set for eviction-induced incoherence (20 cases); (B) recurrent incident pattern doc + alert tuning; (C) regression harness change to run eviction scenarios nightly; (D) a lightweight chaos script to simulate shard restart during high-concurrency warmups.
Yara: I'll take A (prompt/regression set). I want recorded traces + synthetic variants. Est 4 work days. ETA 2024-08-02.
Carlos: I'll take B (pattern doc + alerts). Will collaborate with SRE on thresholds and add runbook links. ETA 2024-07-28.
Mina: Who can update the regression harness nightly job (C)? Need someone who knows the runner.
Yara: I can pair on C after A lands, but tag Dan in case of runner infra changes.
DevOps-bot: Noted: maintenance window available staging 2024-08-06 01:00-02:00 UTC. React :thumbsup: to accept.
Mina: D (chaos script) should be a 30-minute drill on staging, minimal blast radius. Carlos, loop Eng-SRE for approvals.
Carlos: Will set up SRE review and schedule.
Mina: Action summary:
- AI-1: Prompt/regression set for KV-eviction incoherence  owner: Yara  due: 2024-08-02  attach evals + pass/fail criteria.
- AI-2: Incident-pattern doc + alert tuning  owner: Carlos  due: 2024-07-28  include retrospective examples and tuned thresholds.
- AI-3: Nightly eviction regression job in harness  owner: Yara (lead) + Dan (runner infra)  due: 2024-08-09.
- AI-4: 30-min chaos script + staging runbook  owner: Carlos  due: 2024-08-12.
Yara: Small note b keep per-test runtime under 30s to avoid CI blowup; move full-runs to nightly.
Carlos: I'll add AI tickets to the postmortem board and tag "recurrence" + "evals".
ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up review 2024-07-25 14:00 UTC  attendees: Mina, Yara, Carlos.
Mina: Thanks. If infra blocks appear, escalate to Eng-Platform so we don't miss the monthly release gate.
Yara: PRs incoming: prompt draft (WIP) and small harness tweaks to mock eviction.
Carlos: Pattern doc draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/kv-patterns (WIP).
Mina: Perfect. I'll review PRs and check in at the follow-up.
